name: Sakuranbo Station
original_name: さくらんぼステーション
source:
Transferring into portside private school Seiouga Gakuen, the protagonist meets new friends and enjoys the school life. As spring comes about, his feelings for his classmate become more than just as friends. Since Mer Rouge consists of only female staff, this SLG is supposed to be portray the female perspective and the heroine’s actions more realistically. 

[from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/01/april-2000-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
主角转学进入港口边的私立学校西王学园，结识了新朋友，享受着校园生活。春天到来后，他对同班同学的感情也不再只是朋友之情。

由于 Mer Rouge 只有女性员工，这款 SLG 旨在更真实地描绘女性视角和女主角的行动。

[来自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/01/april-2000-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
